blocks.content: A mute timing only takes effect when attached to a notification policy. You can attach it to the default policy (affects all alerts) or to a specific child policy (affects only matched alerts). Mute timings are not inherited from parent policies.
To attach the mute timing, complete the following steps:

blocks.title: Attach the mute timing to a policy

blocks.content: Navigate to **Alerts & IRM > Alerting > Notification policies**.

Find the notification policy where you want to apply the mute timing and click the edit icon.

Choose the default policy to suppress all alerts, or a child policy to suppress only matched alerts.

In the policy editor, find the **Mute timings** section and select the mute timing you created.

During the mute timing's active window, this policy will suppress notifications for all alerts it handles.
Click **Save policy** to apply the mute timing.
In the next milestone, you'll verify the mute timing configuration.
